We need to actually call search_template_catalog_by_criteria. Provide target SMILES? We don't have. Maybe we can use one of the precursors as target? No.

Maybe the target molecule is the product of HWE: an alkene with carboxylic acid attached to sugar? The precursors each have a fragment "C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O" which is a polyene carboxylic acid. The product likely is the same but without the sugar? Actually the precursors are sugar derivatives with that fragment attached via a double bond? The product maybe is the same polyene carboxylic acid (no sugar). So target SMILES could be "C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O". Let's try that.

Search with functional_groups_formed=["alkene","carboxylic_acid"], functional_groups_broken=["phosphonate","alcohol"].
